Program_Info.Short_Description: Lightweight offline life scheduler for Windows. No cloud, no subscription, machine-code bound license.
Program_Info.Long_Description: LifeScheduler is a lightweight, offline-first life scheduling application built for Windows. It stores all data locally on your machine, requires no cloud account, and uses a machine-code bound lifetime license. Built with Qt/C++, it features a clean interface, fast performance, and zero telemetry or bundled ads.
Program_Info.Keywords: scheduler, productivity, windows, lifetime license, offline, Qt, C++
